title: Current Production Hostinger build evidence push bridge

phases.objective: Run the existing canonical Hostinger Node.js build evidence reporter once for the current zero-diff Production rebuild through a queue-stable trusted-main marker without performing any provider mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted main push changing only the exact Production 5e5178bb build-evidence marker
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A secret-free artifact and bounded Incident 4953 comment identify whether Hostinger created a build after the 2026-08-03T06:16:38Z Production rebuild and report its UUID, state, source SHA evidence, and first failure without changing Hostinger.
steps: Check out the immutable push event SHA and prove it remains an ancestor of current protected main.
Verify the exact first-line token, one changed marker file, and exact GET-only marker body.
Verify the canonical reporter and reporter-test blobs before the first issue write.
Reject duplicate use of the same Production, merge timestamp, reporter blob, and marker binding.
Run the canonical reporter regression without provider credentials.
Perform authenticated GET-only Hostinger build-list inspection for auth.mad4b.com after the Production rebuild timestamp.
Scrub the exact provider token from persisted JSON and Markdown evidence when present.
Upload the structured evidence and publish a bounded classification to Incident 4953.
assertions: The workflow is queue-stable because push execution is bound to github.sha and requires only ancestry in current main, not remote-main equality.
The target account is u338416126 and the domain is auth.mad4b.com.
The expected Production SHA and merge timestamp are fixed to the current zero-diff rebuild.
The canonical reporter contract remains mad4b.hostinger-nodejs-build-evidence.v1.

The provider method is GET only and no build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force update, or external send occurs.
The Hostinger API token is not returned in artifacts or incident comments.
Diagnostic outcomes including no build, pending, running, failed, other SHA, and source-unverified remain publishable and do not authorize restart.

phases.objective: Merge the inert registration, then merge exactly one marker-only trigger and use the resulting build UUID and classification to choose completed-build log inspection or stop before restart.
